{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Holiday Recipes|Holiday]]

Serve your '''pumpkin pie''' warm or cold, topped with [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]] or not!

==Ingredients==

* ¾ [[cookbook:cup|cup]] (180 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ½ [[cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 teaspoon ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* ½ teaspoon ground [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* ¼ teaspoon ground [[cookbook:Clove|cloves]]
* 2 large [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1 can (15 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 425 g) [[cookbook:Pumpkin|pumpkin]]
* 1 can (12 fl oz / 350 ml) [[Cookbook:Condensed Milk|evaporated milk]]
* 1 unbaked 9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Pie Crust|pie shell]]
* [[cookbook:Whipped Cream|Whipped cream]]

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 425°F (210°C)
# Mix sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, and cloves in small bowl. [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] eggs in large bowl; stir in pumpkin and sugar spice mixture. Gradually stir in evaporated milk.  
# Pour into the unbaked pie shell.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 425°F (210°C) for 15 minutes. Reduce temperature to 350°F (180°C), and bake for 40–50 minutes or until knife inserted near center come out clean.
# Cool on wire rack for 2 hours.
# Top with whipped cream before serving.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Make the filling ahead, if you wish, but pour it into the pie shell just before baking to keep the crust crisp.
* The baking instructions start with a high oven temperature, then direct you to reduce the heat partway through baking. This is an important step which allows the crust time to crisp.
* Insert a knife near but not exactly in the center of the pie to test for doneness, as the center will still cook after you take the pie out of the oven.
* 1¾ teaspoons pumpkin pie spice may be substituted for the cinnamon, ginger, and cloves; however, the taste will be slightly different.
